grammar: phr. 不论晴雨；无论如何。可用于表达活动会按计划进行。
collocations: rain or shine; the game will go on, rain or shine
commonMistake: 这是固定表达，用 or 连接 rain 和 shine；不是描述天气的完整句子。

example.english: We will visit the farm, rain or shine.
example.chinese: 无论晴雨，我们都会去农场。

application.prompt: The school trip will happen in any weather. It will go on, ___. A. rain or shine B. hot or coldly
application.solution: A。解析：rain or shine 表示“不论是雨或是晴”。

grammar: v. 影响。及物动词，后接名词作宾语；主语为第三人称单数时用 affects。
collocations: affect the weather; affect people's plans; be affected by
commonMistake: affect 通常是动词“影响”；effect 通常是名词“影响、效果”。

example.english: Heavy rain can affect the football game.
example.chinese: 大雨可能会影响足球比赛。

application.prompt: Cold weather ___ the plants in the garden. A. affects B. effects
application.solution: A。解析：句中需要动词作谓语，affect 的第三人称单数是 affects。

grammar: adj. 干的；干旱的。可作定语或表语；比较级通常为 drier，最高级为 driest。
collocations: dry clothes; dry weather; a dry season
commonMistake: dry 表示“不湿”；wet 表示“湿的”。作动词时 dry 可表示“弄干”。

example.english: The towels are dry now, so we can put them away.
example.chinese: 毛巾现在干了，我们可以把它们收起来。

application.prompt: The rain has stopped, and the ground has no water on it. It is ___. A. dry B. wet
application.solution: A。解析：没有水、干燥的用 dry。

grammar: n. 闪电。通常作不可数名词；可说 a flash of lightning。
collocations: a flash of lightning; lightning and thunder; lightning strike
commonMistake: lightning 通常不可数，不说 a lightning；thunder 是雷声，lightning 是闪电。

example.english: A flash of lightning lit up the dark sky.
example.chinese: 一道闪电照亮了黑暗的天空。

application.prompt: We saw a bright flash of ___ before the thunder. A. lightning B. wind
application.solution: A。解析：闪电可表达为 a flash of lightning。

grammar: adj. 有暴风雨（或暴风雪）的。常修饰 weather、night、day 等名词；由 storm + -y 构成。
collocations: stormy weather; a stormy night; stormy skies
commonMistake: stormy 是形容词；storm 是名词“暴风雨”，也可作动词。

example.english: The stormy weather kept the boats in the harbour.
example.chinese: 暴风雨天气让船只留在港口。

application.prompt: There is heavy rain and strong wind today. It is ___ weather. A. stormy B. sunny
application.solution: A。解析：有暴风雨的天气是 stormy weather。

grammar: n. 北部；北方。常用 in the north、to the north of 表示方位；作专名地区的一部分时首字母可大写。
collocations: in the north; north of the town; the North Pole
commonMistake: 表示在某地北部常说 in the north of；to the north of 表示在其北面（通常不在其范围内）。

example.english: Our school is in the north of the town.
example.chinese: 我们学校在镇子的北部。

application.prompt: The library is inside the northern part of town. It is ___ the north of town. A. in B. to
application.solution: A。解析：在某地区内部用 in the north of。

grammar: n. 西部；西；西方。常用 in the west、to the west of 表示方位。
collocations: in the west; west of the river; the west coast
commonMistake: in the west of 表示在某地区西部；to the west of 表示在其西边。

example.english: The sun sets in the west.
example.chinese: 太阳从西边落下。

application.prompt: The town is inside the western part of the country. It is ___ the west of the country. A. in B. to
application.solution: A。解析：在国家范围内部用 in the west of。

grammar: n. 南部；南；南方。常用 in the south、to the south of 表示方位。
collocations: in the south; south of the city; the South Pole
commonMistake: in the south of 表示在某地区南部；to the south of 表示在其南边。

example.english: Many people travel south for the warmer weather.
example.chinese: 许多人向南旅行，去享受更暖和的天气。

application.prompt: The village lies inside the southern part of the island. It is ___ the south of the island. A. in B. to
application.solution: A。解析：在岛内南部用 in the south of。

grammar: n. 东部；东；东方。常用 in the east、to the east of 表示方位。
collocations: in the east; east of the station; the east coast
commonMistake: in the east of 表示在某地区东部；to the east of 表示在其东边。

example.english: The weather is warmer in the east of the island.
example.chinese: 岛的东部天气更暖和。

application.prompt: The beach is outside and east of the town. It is ___ the east of the town. A. to B. in
application.solution: A。解析：在城镇外部的东边用 to the east of。

grammar: phr. 待在家里；没有外出。stay 后接 in 表示留在室内或家中。
collocations: stay in tonight; stay in because of the rain; stay in and read
commonMistake: stay in 表示不外出；stay at home 也可表示待在家，不能说 stay home in。

example.english: It is snowing, so we will stay in tonight.
example.chinese: 正在下雪，所以我们今晚待在家里。

application.prompt: It is raining hard, so let's ___ and play a board game. A. stay in B. go out
application.solution: A。解析：大雨时留在室内用 stay in。

grammar: adj. 运气好的；带来好运的。可作定语或表语；常用 be lucky to do sth。
collocations: be lucky; a lucky day; be lucky to win
commonMistake: lucky 是形容词；副词“幸运地”是 luckily，名词“运气”是 luck。

example.english: We were lucky to catch the last bus.
example.chinese: 我们很幸运，赶上了末班车。

application.prompt: They won the game by one point. They were ___. A. lucky B. luckily
application.solution: A。解析：be 动词后作表语需要形容词 lucky。

grammar: phr. 你真幸运。常用作独立回应；也可说 You're lucky。
collocations: Lucky you!; You're lucky to ...; lucky for you
commonMistake: lucky you 是对某人幸运经历的回应；不要误写为 luckily you。

example.english: “I got a seat by the window.” “Lucky you!”
example.chinese: “我坐到了靠窗的位置。”“你真幸运！”

application.prompt: “I won two tickets to the match!” “___!” A. Lucky you B. Luck you
application.solution: A。解析：表示“你真幸运”用固定回应 Lucky you!

grammar: v. 沐日光浴；晒太阳。常作不及物动词；现在分词为 sunbathing。
collocations: sunbathe on the beach; go sunbathing; sunbathe in the sun
commonMistake: sunbathe 是动词；名词活动可说 sunbathing，通常不直接说 do sunbathe。

example.english: They like to sunbathe on the beach in the morning.
example.chinese: 他们喜欢早上在海滩晒太阳。

application.prompt: At the beach, Nora lies in the sun to get a tan. She likes to ___. A. sunbathe B. storm
application.solution: A。解析：晒日光浴用 sunbathe。

grammar: phr. 有朝一日；将来某一天。表示不确定的未来时间，常与一般将来时连用。
collocations: some day in the future; I hope to ... some day
commonMistake: some day 指未来某一天；some days 表示“有些日子”，意思不同。

example.english: I hope to see snow in the mountains some day.
example.chinese: 我希望有朝一日能在山里看到雪。

application.prompt: “Will you climb that mountain?” “I hope to do it ___.” A. some day B. yesterday
application.solution: A。解析：some day 表示将来的某一天。

grammar: n. 温度。常用 high/low temperature；询问温度可说 What is the temperature?
collocations: the temperature is 10°C; high temperature; room temperature
commonMistake: 询问天气温度用 What is the temperature?；问天气情况可用 What is the weather like?

example.english: The temperature is below zero this morning.
example.chinese: 今天早晨气温在零度以下。

application.prompt: The weather report says it is 5°C. The ___ is five degrees Celsius. A. temperature B. direction
application.solution: A。解析：摄氏度数值表示温度，用 temperature。

grammar: n. 雪人。复数为 snowmen；复合词中的 man 变为 men。
collocations: make a snowman; build a snowman; a snowman's hat
commonMistake: snowman 的复数是 snowmen，不是 snowmans。

example.english: The children made a snowman after school.
example.chinese: 孩子们放学后堆了一个雪人。

application.prompt: One snowman, two ___. A. snowmen B. snowmans
application.solution: A。解析：snowman 的不规则复数是 snowmen。

grammar: adv. 大量地；沉重地。修饰动词，描述雨雪或动作的程度；由 heavy 变 y 为 i 再加 -ly。
collocations: rain heavily; snow heavily; breathe heavily
commonMistake: rain heavily 中 heavily 修饰动词；heavy rain 中 heavy 是修饰 rain 的形容词。

example.english: It rained heavily during the night.
example.chinese: 夜里下了大雨。

application.prompt: The verb is raining. Choose the correct adverb: It is raining ___. A. heavily B. heavy
application.solution: A。解析：副词 heavily 修饰动词 raining。

grammar: adj. 下雪的；雪白的。常修饰 day、weather、mountain 等名词；由 snow + -y 构成。
collocations: a snowy day; snowy weather; snowy mountains
commonMistake: snowy 是形容词；snow 可作名词“雪”或动词“下雪”。

example.english: We stayed home on the snowy day.
example.chinese: 下雪天我们待在家里。

application.prompt: A day with falling snow is a ___ day. A. snowy B. sunny
application.solution: A。解析：下雪的用 snowy。

grammar: n. 沙滩排球。通常指运动项目时作不可数名词；前置 beach 说明比赛场地。
collocations: play beach volleyball; a beach volleyball game; beach volleyball players
commonMistake: 表示运动项目常说 play beach volleyball，不在 volleyball 前加 a。

example.english: We played beach volleyball before the rain started.
example.chinese: 下雨前我们打了沙滩排球。

application.prompt: Which sentence names the sport correctly? A. They play beach volleyball. B. They play a beach volleyball.
application.solution: A。解析：指运动项目时 beach volleyball 通常不可数。

grammar: adj. 高的；adv. 在高处/向高处。作形容词修饰名词，作副词修饰动作或位置；常用于山、温度、价格、飞行高度等。
collocations: a high mountain; high temperature; fly high; high above the sea
commonMistake: high 常说山、温度、价格或位置高；描述人的身高通常用 tall。

example.english: The temperature is high in the afternoon.
example.chinese: 下午气温很高。

application.prompt: The afternoon temperature is 30°C. It is very ___. A. high B. tall
application.solution: A。解析：表示气温高用 high；tall 不修饰 temperature。

grammar: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的。可作定语或表语；It's freezing 表示“天气冷极了”。
collocations: freezing cold; freezing weather; freezing temperatures
commonMistake: freezing 表示非常冷；frozen 常表示已经冻住的状态，如 frozen water。

example.english: It was freezing, so we wore warm coats.
example.chinese: 天气冷极了，所以我们穿上了暖和的外套。

application.prompt: An adjective for extremely cold weather is ___. A. freezing B. frozen
application.solution: A。解析：freezing 可形容天气冷极了；frozen 表示被冻住的状态。

grammar: n. 旅行者；观光客。可数名词，单数前通常要有限定词；复数为 tourists。
collocations: a tourist; tourist information; a tourist attraction
commonMistake: tourist 指旅行观光的人；tourism 是“旅游业”，tour 是“旅行、参观”。

example.english: The tourist asked for a map of the town.
example.chinese: 这位游客要了一张城镇地图。

application.prompt: One person visiting a place for fun is a ___. A. tourist B. temperature
application.solution: A。解析：tourist 是旅行观光的人。

grammar: n. （仅用于地名）山；山峰。常置于山名之前并大写，如 Mount Huangshan；可缩写为 Mt.。
collocations: Mount Huangshan; Mount Everest; climb a mountain
commonMistake: 专名中 Mount + 山名一般不加 the；普通名词“山”用 mountain。

example.english: Mount Huangshan is famous for its clouds and peaks.
example.chinese: 黄山以云海和山峰闻名。

application.prompt: Choose the correct place name: A. Mount Huangshan B. the Mount Huangshan
application.solution: A。解析：Mount + 山名作专名时通常不加 the。

grammar: n. 云；云彩。通常是可数名词，复数为 clouds；cloudy 是形容词“多云的”。
collocations: a white cloud; dark clouds; a cloud in the sky
commonMistake: cloud 是名词，cloudy 是形容词；描述天气说 It's cloudy。

example.english: Dark clouds are moving across the sky.
example.chinese: 乌云正在天空中移动。

application.prompt: There are many ___ in the sky before the storm. A. clouds B. cloudys
application.solution: A。解析：cloud 的复数是 clouds；cloudy 是形容词。

examTags: 语法·like后接名词或动名词
grammar: phr. 感觉像；也可表示想要。表示“感觉像”后接名词；表示“想做”后接名词或动名词，不接 to do。
collocations: feel like rain; feel like a dream; feel like walking
commonMistake: feel like doing sth 表示“想做某事”；不能说 feel like to do sth。

example.english: The cool wind feels like a soft touch.
example.chinese: 凉爽的风感觉像轻柔的触碰。

application.prompt: I want to walk by the lake. I feel like ___ by the lake. A. walking B. to walk
application.solution: A。解析：feel like 后接名词或动名词，动词用 walking。

grammar: adj. 魔法的；神奇的。可修饰名词或作表语；由 magic + -al 构成。
collocations: a magical place; a magical moment; seem magical
commonMistake: magical 是形容词；magic 可作名词“魔法”或形容词“有魔力的”。

example.english: The snowy forest looked magical at sunrise.
example.chinese: 日出时的雪林看起来神奇极了。

application.prompt: We need an adjective to describe the view. The view is ___. A. magical B. magically
application.solution: A。解析：be 后作表语用形容词 magical。

grammar: n. 岩石。通常是可数名词；一块岩石可说 a rock，复数为 rocks。
collocations: a large rock; rocks on the beach; rock formation
commonMistake: rock 表示“岩石”时是可数名词；rock music 中 rock 指摇滚乐。

example.english: A small crab hid under a rock.
example.chinese: 一只小螃蟹躲在岩石下面。

application.prompt: One large ___ blocked the path. A. rock B. rocks
application.solution: A。解析：one 后接单数名词 rock。

examTags: 语法·可数名词与固定搭配
grammar: n. 休息；剩余部分。表示休息时可说 have/take a rest；表示剩余部分常用 the rest of。
collocations: take a rest; have a short rest; the rest of the day
commonMistake: a rest 表示一次休息；the rest of 表示“其余的……”，后接名词。

example.english: After the long walk, we took a rest by the lake.
example.chinese: 长途步行后，我们在湖边休息了一会儿。

application.prompt: We walked for two hours. Let's ___ a rest. A. take B. do
application.solution: A。解析：固定搭配是 take a rest。

grammar: n. 场地；地区。可数名词，常用 an area of + 名词表示一片/一块区域。
collocations: a large area; a play area; an area of forest
commonMistake: area 是可数名词，单数通常要用 a/an 或其他限定词。

example.english: The picnic area is beside the river.
example.chinese: 野餐区在河边。

application.prompt: The children can play safely in ___ area near the visitor centre. A. an B. a
application.solution: A。解析：area 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。

grammar: n. 休息区。由 rest + area 构成，可数；复数为 rest areas。
collocations: a roadside rest area; stop at a rest area; rest area facilities
commonMistake: rest area 指供人休息的地点；a rest area 的中心词是可数名词 area。

example.english: The driver stopped at a rest area to drink some water.
example.chinese: 司机在休息区停下来喝了些水。

application.prompt: We stopped at ___ rest area beside the highway. A. a B. an
application.solution: A。解析：rest area 是名词短语，冠词后紧接 rest；rest 以辅音音素开头，所以用 a。

grammar: phr. 取得进展。progress 通常不可数，前面不加 a，也通常不用复数。
collocations: make progress; make progress in English; make great progress
commonMistake: progress 通常不可数，说 make progress，不说 make a progress 或 make progresses。

example.english: With daily practice, Leo made progress in swimming.
example.chinese: 通过每天练习，利奥在游泳方面取得了进步。

application.prompt: After a week of practice, Kim has made ___ in reading. A. progress B. a progress
application.solution: A。解析：progress 通常不可数，不加 a。

grammar: conj. 虽然；尽管。引导让步状语从句；从句可放句首或主句后。
collocations: Although it is cold, ...; ... although it is raining
commonMistake: although 和 but 通常不在同一个句子里同时使用；可用 Although ..., 主句。

example.english: Although the wind was strong, the hikers continued slowly.
example.chinese: 虽然风很大，徒步者还是慢慢继续前行。

application.prompt: ___ it was raining, the players continued the match. A. Although B. Despite
application.solution: A。解析：后面是完整句子；although 接从句，despite 后接名词或动名词。

grammar: adv. 还；仍然。常放在 be 动词后、实义动词前；用于否定句时常放在助动词后。
collocations: still raining; still live here; still not ready
commonMistake: still 表示情况持续；yet 常用于否定句或疑问句句末表示“还、尚”。

example.english: It was late, but the hikers were still on the path.
example.chinese: 天已经晚了，但徒步者仍在路上。

application.prompt: The rain has not stopped. It is ___ raining. A. still B. yet
application.solution: A。解析：still 常放在进行时前表示动作仍在持续。

grammar: phr. 情绪高涨；兴高采烈。常作表语，前面用 be；spirits 在此用复数。
collocations: be in high spirits; arrive in high spirits; keep someone in high spirits
commonMistake: 固定表达用 in high spirits；不要把 spirits 写成单数 spirit。

example.english: The team was in high spirits after the hike.
example.chinese: 徒步结束后，队员们兴高采烈。

application.prompt: Everyone is smiling and celebrating. They are ___. A. in high spirits B. at high spirit
application.solution: A。解析：固定搭配是 in high spirits。

grammar: n. & v. 经历；经验；经历。作名词表示一般经验时常不可数；表示一次具体经历时可数；作动词表示经历。
collocations: have experience; a good experience; experience bad weather
commonMistake: 表示“经验”通常不可数；表示“一次经历”可说 an experience。

example.english: Our guide has experience hiking in cold weather.
example.chinese: 我们的向导有在寒冷天气徒步的经验。

application.prompt: Last week, the hikers ___ heavy rain in the mountains. A. experienced B. experience
application.solution: A。解析：last week 表示过去时间，experience 作动词用过去式 experienced。

grammar: prep. 穿过；凭借。表示从内部穿过某个空间或物体；也可表示通过某种方式。
collocations: walk through the forest; look through a window; learn through practice
commonMistake: through 强调从内部穿过；across 强调从一边到另一边，通常跨过表面或开阔区域。

example.english: We walked through the forest to reach the lake.
example.chinese: 我们穿过森林到达湖边。

application.prompt: The path goes inside the forest and comes out on the other side. We walk ___ the forest. A. through B. over
application.solution: A。解析：从森林内部穿过用 through；over 表示在上方或越过。

grammar: adj. 高兴的。常用 be glad to do sth 或 be glad that + 从句。
collocations: be glad to help; be glad that; glad to hear
commonMistake: glad 后可接 to do 或 that 从句；“我很高兴见到你”说 I'm glad to see you。

example.english: We are glad to see the sun after the storm.
example.chinese: 暴风雨后看到太阳，我们很高兴。

application.prompt: I am happy to help you. I am ___ to help you. A. glad B. gladly
application.solution: A。解析：be 后作表语用形容词 glad。

grammar: n. 山顶；顶点。可数名词，常指山峰或某事物达到的最高点。
collocations: reach the peak; a mountain peak; at its peak
commonMistake: peak 是可数名词，单数前通常需要 the、a 或其他限定词。

example.english: The hikers reached the peak before noon.
example.chinese: 徒步者中午前到达了山顶。

application.prompt: We had been talking about the mountain's highest point. After a long climb, they stood on ___ peak. A. the B. a
application.solution: A。解析：前文已指出特定的最高峰，用 the peak。

grammar: adj. 灰色的。可作定语或表语；grey 是英式拼法，gray 是美式拼法。
collocations: grey clouds; a grey coat; turn grey
commonMistake: grey 和 gray 意思相同，分别常见于英式和美式拼写；写作时全文保持一种拼法。

example.english: Grey clouds covered the mountain in the morning.
example.chinese: 早晨灰云笼罩着山。

application.prompt: This textbook uses British spelling. Choose the word for 灰色的: A. grey B. gray
application.solution: A。解析：英式拼写为 grey；gray 是美式拼写。

grammar: phr. 因为。介词短语，后接名词、代词或动名词；because 后接完整句子。
collocations: because of the rain; because of bad weather; because of being late
commonMistake: because of + 名词/代词/动名词；because + 主语 + 谓语。

example.english: The match was delayed because of the storm.
example.chinese: 比赛因暴风雨而推迟。

application.prompt: The flight was late ___ the fog. A. because of B. because
application.solution: A。解析：the fog 是名词短语，前面用 because of。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: because or because of

grammar: n. 雾。通常作不可数名词；foggy 是形容词“有雾的”。
collocations: thick fog; fog in the morning; foggy weather
commonMistake: fog 是名词，foggy 是形容词；描述天气说 It is foggy。

example.english: Thick fog covered the road early this morning.
example.chinese: 今天清晨浓雾笼罩着道路。

application.prompt: The noun for the cloud near the ground is ___. A. fog B. foggy
application.solution: A。解析：fog 是名词；foggy 是形容词。

grammar: n. 地面。表示地面时常作不可数名词，常见搭配 on the ground、fall to the ground。
collocations: on the ground; wet ground; fall to the ground
commonMistake: 表示“地面”时说 on the ground，不说 on ground；ground 还可指场地或理由。

example.english: The wet leaves covered the ground.
example.chinese: 湿树叶铺满了地面。

application.prompt: The keys fell ___ the ground. A. on B. at
application.solution: A。解析：表示落在地面上常用 on the ground。

grammar: adj. 湿的。可作定语或表语；比较级和最高级通常双写 t 再加 -er、-est：wetter、wettest。
collocations: get wet; wet clothes; wet weather
commonMistake: wet 是形容词；说“被雨淋湿”可用 get wet；比较级写 wetter，双写 t。

example.english: My shoes got wet in the rain.
example.chinese: 我的鞋子被雨淋湿了。

application.prompt: After walking in the rain, Sam's jacket was ___. A. wet B. dry
application.solution: A。解析：雨淋后衣服是湿的，用 wet。

grammar: adj. 令人疲倦的；累人的。描述事情或活动给人的感受；人的感受用 tired。
collocations: a tiring walk; a tiring day; very tiring
commonMistake: tiring 描述令人疲倦的事情；tired 描述感到疲倦的人。

example.english: The long walk was tiring, but the view was beautiful.
example.chinese: 长途步行很累人，但景色很美。

application.prompt: After a five-hour hike, I feel ___. A. tired B. tiring
application.solution: A。解析：描述“我感到累”用 tired；tiring 描述使人累的事。

grammar: v. 似乎；好像。常用 seem + 形容词、seem to do 或 seem like + 名词。
collocations: seem happy; seem to be; seem like a good idea
commonMistake: seem 作系动词时后接形容词，不用副词：The sky seems grey。

example.english: The mountain seems quiet after the rain.
example.chinese: 雨后的山似乎很安静。

application.prompt: The clouds ___ dark, so we should take our raincoats. A. seem B. seemly
application.solution: A。解析：系动词 seem 后接形容词 dark。

grammar: n. 阳光；日光。通常作不可数名词；可说 a ray of sunlight。
collocations: bright sunlight; direct sunlight; a ray of sunlight
commonMistake: sunlight 通常不可数，不说 a sunlight；表示一束阳光可说 a ray of sunlight。

example.english: The plants need sunlight and water to grow.
example.chinese: 植物生长需要阳光和水。

application.prompt: The noun for light from the sun is ___. A. sunlight B. a sunlight
application.solution: A。解析：sunlight 通常不可数，不加 a。

grammar: phr. 在顶部；在顶端。常用 at the top of + 名词，表示最高处或页面最上方。
collocations: at the top of the mountain; at the top of the page; reach the top
commonMistake: at the top of 表示处于顶部；on top of 通常强调在某物表面上或“此外”。

example.english: A small flag stood at the top of the hill.
example.chinese: 小山顶上立着一面小旗。

application.prompt: The title is in the highest part of the page. It is ___ the top of the page. A. at B. in
application.solution: A。解析：在页面顶端用 at the top of。

grammar: n. 想法。是可数名词；单数前通常有限定词，复数为 thoughts。
collocations: a good thought; share your thoughts; have a thought
commonMistake: thought 作名词意为“想法”；它也是 think 的过去式和过去分词，需根据句子位置判断词性。

example.english: I had a thought about how to keep the trail clean.
example.chinese: 我想到一个保持步道清洁的办法。

application.prompt: She shared an interesting ___ with the group. A. thought B. think
application.solution: A。解析：an 后接名词 thought；think 是动词。

grammar: n. 山；高山。可数名词，单数前通常需要限定词；复数为 mountains。
collocations: a high mountain; a mountain range; climb a mountain
commonMistake: mountain 是普通名词；专名中的 Mount + 山名大写且通常不加 the。

example.english: Clouds covered the top of the mountain.
example.chinese: 云层覆盖了山顶。

application.prompt: The hikers climbed ___ mountain near the village. A. a B. an
application.solution: A。解析：mountain 以辅音音素开头，单数前用 a。

grammar: phr. 开始；起初。常接 of + 名词说明某活动或时间段的起点。
collocations: at the start of the trip; at the start of the day; from start to finish
commonMistake: at the start of 指某事开始时；start 作动词时可表示“开始做”。

example.english: At the start of the walk, the sky was clear.
example.chinese: 徒步刚开始时，天空晴朗。

application.prompt: ___ the start of the lesson, the teacher checked the weather chart. A. At B. In
application.solution: A。解析：固定时间表达为 at the start of。

examTags: 语法·可数名词与介词短语
grammar: n. 末尾；结束。可数名词，常见结构有 at the end of 和 in the end；也可作动词“结束”。
collocations: the end of the road; at the end; in the end
commonMistake: at the end of 指某段时间或事物的末尾；in the end 表示“最后、终于”。

example.english: There is a bus stop at the end of this road.
example.chinese: 这条路的尽头有一个公交站。

application.prompt: The final scene is ___ the end of the film. A. at B. in
application.solution: A。解析：电影的结尾位置用 at the end of。

grammar: phr. 在末尾；最后。常接 of + 具体时间、道路、故事等，表示终点位置或时间。
collocations: at the end of the day; at the end of the road; at the end of the story
commonMistake: at the end of 是“在……末尾”；in the end 是“最后、终于”，不是具体位置。

example.english: At the end of the trail, we saw a small lake.
example.chinese: 在步道的尽头，我们看到一个小湖。

application.prompt: The last page is ___ the end of the book. A. at B. in
application.solution: A。解析：表示书的最后位置用 at the end of。

grammar: n. 暴风雨；暴风雪。通常作可数名词；也可作动词表示“猛冲”。
collocations: a heavy storm; a snowstorm; after the storm
commonMistake: storm 是名词，stormy 是形容词；a storm 可数，stormy weather 中 weather 不可数。

example.english: The storm damaged several trees in the park.
example.chinese: 暴风雨损坏了公园里的几棵树。

application.prompt: The weather report warns that ___ storm may arrive tonight. A. a B. an
application.solution: A。解析：storm 是辅音音素开头的可数名词单数，用 a。

grammar: v. 倾倒；倒出。常用 pour A into B；描述大雨时可说 rain pours down。
collocations: pour water into a cup; pour out tea; rain pours down
commonMistake: 倒液体进容器用 pour ... into ...；雨下得很大可用 It is pouring。

example.english: Please pour the warm tea into this cup.
example.chinese: 请把热茶倒进这个杯子里。

application.prompt: The glass is empty. Please ___ some water into it. A. pour B. freeze
application.solution: A。解析：把水倒进杯子用 pour ... into ...。

grammar: n. 风。表示空气流动时通常不可数；可用 strong、cold 等形容词修饰。
collocations: strong wind; cold wind; the wind is blowing
commonMistake: 表示天气中的风，wind 通常不可数；windy 是形容词“有风的”。

example.english: A cold wind blew across the field.
example.chinese: 一阵冷风吹过田野。

application.prompt: The noun for moving air is ___. A. wind B. windy
application.solution: A。解析：wind 是名词；windy 是形容词。

grammar: v. & n. 喊叫；呼唤。作动词可说 shout to sb（让对方听见）或 shout at sb（常带生气语气）。
collocations: shout for help; shout to a friend; give a shout
commonMistake: shout to someone 通常为让对方听见；shout at someone 常表示冲某人大声喊。

example.english: She shouted to her friend across the windy field.
example.chinese: 她隔着风大的田野向朋友喊话。

application.prompt: You want your friend far away to hear you. You shout ___ your friend. A. to B. at
application.solution: A。解析：为了让远处的人听见，用 shout to。

grammar: phr. 追逐；追赶。run after 后接被追赶的人或物；after 后的宾语不能移到 run 和 after 之间。
collocations: run after a bus; run after a ball; run after someone
commonMistake: run after 表示追赶；不能说 run a bus after。

example.english: The boy ran after his hat in the strong wind.
example.chinese: 男孩在大风中追赶自己的帽子。

application.prompt: The dog chased the ball across the park. It ran ___ the ball. A. after B. for
application.solution: A。解析：追赶某物用 run after。

grammar: n. 安娜（人名）。人名是专有名词，首字母大写；所属关系可写 Anna's。
collocations: Anna's family; meet Anna; ask Anna a question
commonMistake: 英文人名首字母大写；句中写作 Anna，不写 anna。

example.english: Anna checked the weather before the walk.
example.chinese: 安娜在徒步前查看了天气。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written name: A. Anna B. anna
application.solution: A。解析：人名 Anna 是专有名词，首字母大写。

grammar: n. 约翰（人名）。人名是专有名词，首字母大写；所属关系可写 John's。
collocations: John's family; meet John; ask John for help
commonMistake: 英文人名首字母大写；句中写作 John，不写 john。

example.english: John stayed in because the storm was strong.
example.chinese: 因为暴风雨很大，约翰待在家里。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written name: A. John B. john
application.solution: A。解析：人名 John 是专有名词，首字母大写。

grammar: n. 斯德哥尔摩（瑞典首都）。城市名首字母大写；表示“在斯德哥尔摩”用 in Stockholm。
collocations: in Stockholm; travel to Stockholm; Stockholm, Sweden
commonMistake: Stockholm 是城市专名，首字母大写；不要在城市名前随意加 the。

example.english: Stockholm is the capital of Sweden.
example.chinese: 斯德哥尔摩是瑞典的首都。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly capitalized city name: A. Stockholm B. stockholm
application.solution: A。解析：城市专名 Stockholm 首字母大写。

grammar: n. 黄山。专有地名，Mount 和 Huangshan 首字母大写；Mount + 山名通常不加 the。
collocations: visit Mount Huangshan; climb Mount Huangshan; the peaks of Mount Huangshan
commonMistake: 专名中通常说 Mount Huangshan，不说 the Mount Huangshan；普通“山”用 mountain。

example.english: Mount Huangshan is known for its cloudy peaks.
example.chinese: 黄山以云雾缭绕的山峰闻名。

application.prompt: Choose the correct place name: A. Mount Huangshan B. the Mount Huangshan
application.solution: A。解析：Mount + 山名作专有名称时通常不加 the。

grammar: n. 光明顶（黄山山峰名）。地名首字母大写；英文官方介绍中也称 Bright Summit。
collocations: Bright Peak on Mount Huangshan; reach Bright Peak; view from Bright Peak
commonMistake: Bright Peak 是地名，两个词首字母都大写；不要写成 bright peak。

example.english: The hikers watched the sunrise from Bright Peak.
example.chinese: 徒步者在光明顶观看日出。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written peak name: A. Bright Peak B. bright peak
application.solution: A。解析：地名中 Bright 和 Peak 都首字母大写。
